correctness.rationale: For f,g holomorphic near the interior accumulation point 0, matching asymptotic orders and matching leading phase allow first mismatched coefficient m to produce 2 Re(conj(c) delta exp(inm theta))=O(rho^n). Irrational phases are dense, forcing delta=0; rational periodic phases cannot vanish for m<q, while 1±iz^q give ambiguity. For degree d<q, the lifted bases lambda_jk=rho^(j+k) exp(i(j-k)theta) have distinct magnitudes or distinct angular differences and hence are all distinct. The first (d+1)^2 samples form an invertible generalized Vandermonde; recovering the Hermitian Gram matrix gives coefficients up to phase. Its count is minimal for linear recovery of unconstrained Hermitian lifts, not for nonlinear rank-one data. Independent exact determinant at d=1, rho=1/2, theta=pi/2 is -75/2048; 66 combinatorial (d,q) distinctness cases checked.
